authoritative_for: Geste owns manual episode identity, immutable revision order, authored case interpretation, validation, deterministic retrieval and read-time projections, and its product packaging.
not_authoritative_for: Each cited source product remains authoritative for its referenced record and current truth, while the caller owns whether a precedent is analogous or applicable now.

covers: All supported public Geste CLI outcomes for manual episode capture and exploration, installation and diagnosis, and product development in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, direct SQLite access, automatic ingestion, model inference, source adapters, implementation helpers, and current runtime readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: Geste surfaces are local-user CLI and explicitly selected local-database operations; no provider entry grants access to a cited source system.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Geste state may contain private episode prose and source locators, but it stores no cited upstream source body and publishes no network surface.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes; entry contract versions, capture schema versions, and database schema versions remain distinct compatibility axes.
operational_limits: Geste is a bounded manual casebook CLI with no daemon, scheduler, continuous observer, model workflow, or source crawler; per-entry bounds govern each operation.
